text:
maria_support: customer emailed that applying promo code REDWOOD50 returns 'invalid or expired' when they try to apply it during upgrade. They say they never redeemed it. Screenshot shows error: promo_code.invalid_or_expired
ellie_support: can you grab the account id, exact string they typed, and timezone/region? sometimes marketing codes are region-locked or single-use
maria_support: acct: acct_9132, code they pasted: REDWOOD50 (all caps, no spaces). Region: US-West. Attached console snippet: `{"error":"promo_code.invalid_or_expired","code":"PROMO_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED"}`
devin_billing: checking promos table now... looking for REDWOOD50
devin_billing: quick note — there's a marketing batch REDWOOD50 that expired 2025-11-30. also a separate testing variant REDWOOD50_TEST active. possible user copied wrong code from somewhere
sam_engineer: pulled redemption logs for promo id 9876 (REDWOOD50 main batch) — it shows one redemption on 2025-12-02 by acct_2048. The validation path returns 410 when redeemed_count >= max_redemptions. I can trace the exact request if you want request ids
maria_support: customer insists they never used it; could be leakage or someone else used it. we should offer goodwill while we investigate. can billing issue a manual credit and disable the code to avoid more confusion?
devin_billing: yes we can do a one-time $50 credit to acct_9132 and mark the promo batch as expired to prevent further redemptions. creating internal ticket B-4521 now. ETA ~30m for manual credit to reflect
ops_bot: billing-bot: Ticket B-4521 created by devin_billing. Manual credit ($50) queued for acct_9132.
ellie_support: just messaged the customer: "We applied a one-time $50 account credit while we investigate. Sorry for the trouble — if you'd like a new single-use promo code we can issue one and set a 30-day expiry." Customer replied: "Thanks, I'd appreciate a fresh code"
devin_billing: generating single-use code now — created RW-50-6K8P, single-use, expires in 30 days. Added note to ticket: do not reuse marketing batch codes. Pasting code to customer thread and invalidating marketing batch REDWOOD50
maria_support: replying to customer with RW-50-6K8P and instructions for redeeming in Billing > Apply promo. asked them to confirm once applied. marking this thread as awaiting customer confirmation. :white_check_mark:
